 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORD % 14.02.2024 1.

The present petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('CrPC'),
for quashing of FIR No. 127/2019, dated 11.03.2019, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC'), registered at Police Station Nangloi.
2. The FIR was registered on a complaint by the Respondent No. 2, alleging that she was subjected to cruelty.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the parties have settled their disputes and have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding dated 21.10.2023.
4. He submits that, pursuant to the settlement, the parties have already obtained a decree of divorce.
5. The settlement was arrived at with the intervention of common friends and relatives.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/02/2024 at 23:19:29 6.
He submits that in terms of the settlement, a sum of 55,000/- has already been paid to the complainant and the balance amount of 25,000/- shall be paid at the time of quashing of the FIR.
